ab.note: gtol_gscale_factor and xtol: the X-TOCV optimizer-tolerance rule of record (a1_toc_variational_jax.py main, OPT stage: gtol = max(tol_dp, 1e-8 |g|), xtol = 1e-10), copied so that P-3 runs at the UNCHANGED derived gtol; o31_seed: the X-TOCV O3.1 probe direction seed (np.random.default_rng(1)); p3_max_segments: the budget cap of the P-3 re-optimisation under J_A (the tilt moves theta_B by ~ tilt / H_00 ~ 1e-5 rad, one or two segments expected; a cap reached is a FAIL, never a pass); ladder_r: the two resolutions of the value-axis ladder (theta_1 halved); dv_floor: the driver's Jacobi clamp (run_trsqp precond: Dv = 1/sqrt(max(|h|, 1e-6 max|h|)))
